entities.name: Cyprian Kizito Lwanga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cyprian Kizito Lwanga was a Ugandan Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Kampala from 2006 until his death in 2021. From 1996 to 2006, he served as Bishop of Kasana–Luweero.
